suggestedBatches.label: Trigger mask family
suggestedBatches.reason: Observed shared initializer 0x52d160 links all three conditions. Check bit-index/shift ABI and both player slots before extending to the global trigger updater.

suggestedBatches.label: Gizmo endpoint and playback cluster
suggestedBatches.reason: Three exact shared handlers and established registry/animation callback boundaries provide reuse. Distinct obstacle versus special initializers must remain explicit.

suggestedBatches.label: Locator, movement and opponent controllers
suggestedBatches.reason: High aggregate use, but deeper runtime dependencies. Split lookup/argument contracts from motion, navigation and target-lifecycle effects.

value.interpretation: Warnings come from the source-preserving catalog parser, not the native engine. Original source lines are preserved; malformed quotes, duplicate/legacy directives and permissive native parsing can differ.

parserWarnings.qualification: Retained catalog warnings; this audit did not reparse or repair scripts.

limitations: A use count measures preserved authored occurrences, including alternate files; it is not execution frequency or gameplay importance.
A native binding does not establish semantics, and a shared function address does not establish identical initializer behavior.
Pseudocode line/callee counts are only review heuristics. Indirect calls, allocator effects, character lifetime, global setup and rendering can dominate actual work.
Unbound names require native parser/loader and source-reachability review; no automatic typo substitutions are authorized or applied.

completedPriorityBatches.label: Compact high-use conditions
completedPriorityBatches.reason: Highest expected bounded-fixture yield. Validate native value/sentinel behavior plus condition initializer, not just the small reader body.

completedPriorityBatches.label: Spawn lifecycle
completedPriorityBatches.reason: CreateCreatures remains uncontracted. Kill has an externally owned bounded dispatch contract; downstream death and parts effects remain open.

externalCompletedContracts.name: Kill
externalCompletedContracts.scope: Bounded command selection and dispatch only; name/reference/numeric services and downstream parts/death effects remain explicit boundaries.

externalCompletedContracts.name: CnxController
externalCompletedContracts.scope: Bounded command parsing, constructor, connection matching, pool/list operations, frame-mask building and controller update. World target/path bindings and generic gizmo-output callbacks are explicit adapters; no live pathfinder or locomotion.
externalCompletedContracts.countQualification: Eight pool-sequence aggregate checks overlap their underlying 528 pool checks; this external total is not an independent-case count and is excluded from gameplay totals.
